title: iOS Developer Intern
description:
**Job Description**

We are looking for a motivated **iOS Developer Intern** with hands\-on experience in iOS application development. The candidate should be capable of working independently and contributing to real\-world projects.

**Responsibilities**

Develop and maintain iOS applications

Build new features and improve existing applications

Work with Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, and REST APIs

Debug and resolve technical issues

Test and optimize applications for performance

Collaborate with team members and project managers

Manage application updates and releases

**Requirements**

Strong knowledge of Swift and iOS development

Good understanding of SwiftUI and UIKit

Experience with REST APIs and third\-party integrations

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

Strong problem\-solving skills

**Preferred Skills (Optional)**

Experience with Core Data or other databases

Knowledge of Git and version control

Experience with App Store deployment

**Benefits**

Career growth opportunities

Learning\-focused work environment

Supportive team culture

Kindly share your resume to hafis.hmc@3hntrypz.com

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹6,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
